summary.zh: 把生产提示词纳入版本与评测流程
summary.en: Version, test and release production prompts like code.

description.zh: 为已在生产环境运行的提示词建立发布流程：版本管理、提示词登记、A/B 测试、回归检查和评测流水线。适合提示词数量变多、改动频繁且担心影响线上效果时使用。单条提示词的质量打磨不属于这里。
description.en: Sets up a release process for production prompts: versioning, a registry, A/B tests, regression checks and an eval pipeline. Use it when prompt count grows and changes risk breaking live behavior; polishing one prompt is a different job.
